packageRules.description: Auto-merge patch and minor updates once every check passes.
Group the GitHub Actions digest bumps into one PR.

A major update to a load-bearing dependency gets a review, never auto-merge. Runtime deps (see the decisions log for the Typer floor) plus the build backend and the release tool, whose majors can break packaging or `cz bump`.
